description: This file is a web interface source file for configuring local IP settings on a gateway device, including IPv4 and IPv6 network configurations. It contains PHP code to generate the HTML form with current network settings, and embedded JavaScript to handle form validation, dynamic updates, and AJAX requests to apply changes.

methods.name: validate_v4addr_pool
methods.description: Validates that the DHCP range start address is less than or equal to the end address for IPv4.

methods.name: validate_v6addr_pool
methods.description: Validates that the DHCPv6 beginning address is less than or equal to the ending address.

methods.name: calcuate_lease_time
methods.description: Calculates lease time in seconds based on input number and unit.

methods.name: display_time_format
methods.description: Converts numerical lease time into human-readable form and updates the form fields.

methods.name: display_time_format_V6
methods.description: Similar to display_time_format but for IPv6 lease times.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address string into an array of 8 hextets.

methods.name: updateIPv6
methods.description: Enables or disables IPv6 IPv6 address editing fields based on checkbox state.

methods.name: stateful_check
methods.description: Handles UI changes based on IPv6 stateful/stateless selection.
